items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) against the Mahnbescheid
items.quote: Ihnen bleiben zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung.
items.computation: The Mahnbescheid was formally delivered by being placed in the mailbox, with the delivery person noting the date on the envelope: 'Zugestellt durch Einlegen in den Briefkasten am 23.11.2026'. For formal delivery, the stated date is the delivery day itself (no days are added). 23.11.2026 is a Monday. The period is 'zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung' (two weeks from delivery). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (23.11.2026) is not counted when counting forward, but under §188 Abs. 2 BGB a period measured in weeks ends on the day bearing the same designation (weekday) as the day of the event, two weeks later. Two weeks after Monday 23.11.2026 is Monday 07.12.2026. 07.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so the usual end-of-period shift (§222 ZPO / §193 BGB) is not needed. Final deadline: 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the total claimed amount to the creditor (only if you accept the claim)
items.quote: In dieser Zeit sollen Sie den Gesamtbetrag nebst weiteren Zinsen an die Antragstellerin zahlen, wenn Sie die Forderung für berechtigt halten, oder dem Gericht auf dem beigefügten Vordruck mitteilen, ob und wie weit Sie Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Same two-week period as the Widerspruch deadline: delivery by mailbox-insertion is dated 23.11.2026 (Monday) per the envelope note; this date counts as the delivery day with no days added. Under §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB, the two-week period ends on the same weekday two weeks later: Monday 07.12.2026. This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift applies. If the person considers the claim justified, payment of the total amount (272,49 EUR) plus any further interest must reach the creditor by this date to avoid a Vollstreckungsbescheid being requested.

warnings: The court explicitly states it has not examined whether the underlying claim is justified ('Ob das zutrifft, hat das Gericht nicht untersucht.') — the recipient should check the Mobilfunkentgelte claim (June–August 2026, EUR 214,37) against their own records with Beispielfunk Mobilnetz GmbH before deciding whether to pay or file Widerspruch.

If neither payment nor Widerspruch is received within the two-week period, the creditor can request a Vollstreckungsbescheid (default enforcement order) and pursue compulsory enforcement, so a timely reaction (even a partial Widerspruch) is important if the claim is disputed.
